ValidationRule.description: #28092: Restrict Account Segment and Sub Segment on GI Accounts if related IMGA Account has Global Industries as True. Only at IMGA the values can be modified
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Account'))),
OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'Sales (Site)'), ISPICKVAL(Parent.Parent.IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'IM Group (IMGA)'), Parent.Parent.Global_Account__c, OR(ISCHANGED(Account_Segment__c),ISCHANGED(Account_Sub_Segment__c)) ),
AND( ISPICKVAL(IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'Country Parent'), ISPICKVAL(Parent.IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'IM Group (IMGA)'), Parent.Global_Account__c, OR(ISCHANGED(Account_Segment__c),ISCHANGED(Account_Sub_Segment__c)) ) ), $User.UITheme <>'Theme2', $User.UITheme <> 'Theme3' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This is a GI Account. Account Segment & Sub-Segment can only be edited at the IMGA level on GI Accounts.
